name: Stage 1 gate: sample packs change a generated town, deterministically
description: The same kind of generated town with the base game and two cookbook packs (hardy, which hooks into needs, mood and conversation chance, and caffeine, which adds a system) runs a week. Every day is re-simulated on another thread count; the state reloads identically and resumes identically from a snapshot, with every script VM rebuilt. The visible, attributed effect of a hook in the inspector is covered by the runtime tests; this pins that the packs' effect on the world is deterministic and saved.
